name: Nara Snana
occupation: Keeper of the Great Bath / Senior Ritual Elder
daily_routine: sunrise purification rites at the Great Bath
maintaining the Bath's brick and bitumen waterproofing
teaching Toma the sequence of seasonal rites
preparing ceremonies for the river-turning festival
listening to villagers' concerns during evening visits
evening meditation beside the Bath's steps

goals.public_goal: Preserve the town's ritual traditions around water and purification
goals.hidden_goal: Ensure the true purpose of certain older rites survives after her death, even if their original meaning has faded
goals.deep_goal: Understand whether the rites she performs were once practical knowledge about the river, now preserved only as ceremony

beliefs: The Great Bath is sacred, whatever its original purpose truly was
Some knowledge survives longest when it's wrapped in ritual rather than left as plain instruction
Dreams and old songs can preserve truths that plain records lose
The founders who built the first Bath were responding to something real about the river
Rituals matter even when their original meaning has been half-forgotten
